added_lines: . Completed Enrolment Forms should be placed in the box at the back of the church on arrival. They will be brought forward and placed before the altar at the beginning of Mass. Candidates and families are asked to arrive early. Vocations Society of St. Josep h: As we come close to the end of the year, we would like to thank all our donors for their generosity in supporting the society and our seminarians. If anyone would like to or due to pay a subscription to support our work, please leave your donation with any society member or into the Parish Office. Five Saturday Devotion to Our Lady Next devotion will take place on Saturday morning 5th December at 9am in St Michael’s Church. Young at Heart Group wish to thank Paddy and Una for the Bingo session and valuable prizes last time out. Next meeting on Sunday 6th December at 3pm in St Michael’s Community Centre. All over 50’s most welcome. Community Carol Service Friday 11 December, 7.00pm , St Macartin’s Cathedral, Enniskillen: Everyone is warmly invited to this special service celebrating the individuals, volunteers and organisations whose kindness and service strengthen our communities. The evening will feature traditional Christmas carols, seasonal readings, local musicians and some festive Fermanagh touches. Admission is free, and early arrival is advised. Seasonal refreshments and hospitality will follow in the Cathedral Hall. All welcome.
